title: Ribbon Mends the Sky

coreLoop: tap anywhere to guide the cloud-riding hero toward the target
fly into six drifting sky-holes to stitch the sky closed and complete a meta-level
tap a wind demon to bonk it with the staff for bonus points
collect rainbow shards for score and a bonus every third shard
demon collisions cost one of three lives and grant 1.5 seconds of invulnerability
mending six unique holes completes the current six-repair round in the canonical package; endless meta-levels remain a later expansion
losing all three lives ends the run and presents a replay result
fairness: hero movement visibly approaches tap targets and remains clamped within the playfield
all six holes remain reachable and closure has distinct visual and audio feedback
demon collision damage is communicated and invulnerability prevents rapid repeated hits
demon speed and spawn frequency are capped so later meta-levels remain playable
shards are optional rewards and are never required to complete the objective
HUD and touch interactions stay clear of the bottom safe area on phones and tablets

reviewFocus: Assess visual hierarchy between hero, holes, demons, shards, HUD, and instructions.
Check whether the core fantasy of repairing the sky is visible in action, not just described in text.
Evaluate tap-to-move precision, collision readability, invulnerability feedback, and whether the staff/bonk mechanic is discoverable.
Check Chinese text legibility, edge clipping, HUD safe areas, win payoff, and difficulty progression.
Verify that exactly six distinct hole contacts increment holes_stitched once each; optional shard score must not close holes or win the game.
Capture screenshots before and after each hole repair, and assert closed-patch appearance and restart reset on both Chromium and WebKit.
